mapper.sql: c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (c.assignee_work_no IS NULL OR c.assignee_work_no=#{owner}) AND c.customer_number=#{number}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS id,c.customer_number AS phone,c.did_number AS didNumber,c.missed_at AS time, c.missed_reason AS reason,CONCAT(FLOOR(COALESCE(c.wait_duration_ms,0)/1000),'秒') AS duration, COALESCE(j.status,c.status) AS status,c.assignee_work_no AS assigneeWorkNo,c.assignee_work_no AS assignee, c.call_attempts AS callAttempts,CAST(c.last_dial_job_id AS CHAR) AS dialJobId FROM fcc_callback_task c LEFT JOIN fcc_dial_job j ON j.id=c.last_dial_job_id AND j.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE ORDER BY c.priority DESC,c.missed_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_callback_task c WHERE

SELECT c.customer_number AS number,c.call_attempts AS attempts,CAST(c.last_dial_job_id AS CHAR) AS jobId,j.status AS jobStatus,c.status FROM fcc_callback_task c LEFT JOIN fcc_dial_job j ON j.id=c.last_dial_job_id AND j.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.id=#{id} AND (c.assignee_work_no IS NULL OR c.assignee_work_no=#{owner}) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_callback_task SET status='SCHEDULED',assignee_work_no=#{owner},last_dial_job_id=#{job},call_attempts=call_attempts+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND (assignee_work_no IS NULL OR assignee_work_no=#{owner})
